messages:
marie: FYI - noticed a regression after rolling out the INT4 + FP8 profile to staging. Throughput down ~30% and KV cache keeps growing.
aj: when did this hit? :eyes:
marie: started right after the deploy at 09:15 UTC. Repro locally with 50 concurrent chat streams using the mixed-int4 profile.
liam: can you paste repro steps?
marie: short repro:
```
model: mix-int4-fp8-v2
quantization:
  activation_quant: true
  act_bits: 4
  weight_dtype: fp8_e4m3
runtime:
  batch_window_ms: 12
  kernel_cost_model: auto
  kv_cache: prefix-only
```
send 50 parallel streams; prompt len ~64, response len 256.
sarah: any profiler output?
marie: flame shows matmul selection flipping between int4-gemm and bf16-gemm. Flip correlates with KV allocations churn.
marie: kernel selector picks int4 initially then falls back to bf16 for some layers when sequence length increases; allocator resizes packed KV and we see repeated reallocs.
perf-bot: [perf-alert] mix-int4-fp8-v2: latency +30%, mem +1.2GB over 10m.
aj: why flip mid-run? kernel_cost_model is supposed to be deterministic.
liam: the selector uses sequence-length-aware cost: cost = throughput(seq_len) / cache_hit_est. If activation scales change, the quant path may be invalidated.
sarah: calibration drift hypothesis: activation scale estimation widens after warmup causing int4 path to be considered unsafe.
marie: confirmed: per-layer activation scale jumps after ~100 steps for attention_q activations: early ~0.14 -> later ~0.78.
aj: with that magnitude int4 dynamic range fails, so selector picks bf16 for correctness.
liam: that explains kernel flip. But why KV memory grows? shouldn't old buffers be freed?
marie: found allocator logs:
```
W allocator: deferred_free_queue size=432
I kv_packer: migrated kv from int4-pack to bf16-pack at seq=120, old_pack not freed (race)
```
aj: looks like a race during packer migration.
liam: traced it: two concurrent requests trigger migration; both try to migrate and update pointers. One path enqueues old buffer but lost the free mark due to a missed CAS.
marie: proposed fixes:
- CAS-protect packer migration and push old buffers to a deterministic free queue
- smooth per-layer activation scale (exponential moving average, alpha=0.2)
- kernel selector hysteresis so small jitter doesn't flip path

sarah: smoothing + hysteresis sound good. Also add telemetry: kernel_flip_count per model/version.
marie: local patch: added EMA for act scale, CAS around packer migration, and selector hysteresis window of 3 samples. Re-ran stress: throughput back to baseline, KV growth stopped.
perf-bot: [perf-check] stress run: throughput change -1% (noise), mem stable.
aj: please open PR with patch, unit test that simulates concurrent migration, and perf benchmark.
marie: creating PR and INF ticket. PR will include test: two-thread migration race, packer deterministic free, smoothing config, and kernel_flip telemetry.
liam: add alert for kernel_flip_count > 5/min and mem-slope > threshold.
sarah: release note blurb: "Fix packer migration race causing KV buffer leaks and perf regressions under activation quantization." :thumbsup: 
marie: scheduling canary tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Will monitor kernel_flip_count + mem slope for 2h. Closing once PR merges.
aj: nice catch. Good triage.
